childNodes.textContent: SEEK · courses on a career page (recreation)

A recreation of the SEEK Career Advice courses module for the portfolio case study, in SEEK's
     current look (Paper: "Personal website" → "SEEK · mobile screens (current design system)").
     One page, every state of the story behind ?v=:
       release  the first release: a tab per qualification, text-only cards
       all      leak 1 fixed: an All tab, every qualification on one scroll (cards still text-only)
       cards    leak 2: the same module, cards swap to logo + course name (window.swapCards())
       before   leak 3 before: a card leaves for a course page, then an enquiry form page
       after    leak 3 fixed: a card opens a sheet, Enquire opens the form in it
       final    the shipped module (same as after)
